Three short steps: which account, a code to prove it's yours, then the new password. At the end
you're signed in, so there's no second trip through the sign-in page.

<Template name="reset-password" />

## Try it

- Any email continues. The demo answers the same whether or not it has an account.
- `000000` is a wrong code; any other works.
- The new password needs 10 characters.

## Details that matter

- **No one learns who has an account.** The answer is "If this email has an account, a code is on
  its way", for every email.
- **The new password is saved for the right account:** a hidden username field tells password
  managers which one.
- **The end says what happened.** You're signed in, and an email confirms that the password
  changed.
